Praxis FY2024 10-K (0001689548-25-000040): 'ulixacaltamide (formerly known as PRAX-944)'; the NDA accepted on 2026-04-14 is for 'ulixacaltamide HCl' (8-K 0001689548-26-000033). The registry files Essential3 (NCT06087276) under the dose, '60 mg ulixacaltamide'

REGENXBIO Q3 2026 10-Q (0001193125-26-448581): 'Additional clinical-stage candidates include RGX-121 (clemidsogene lanparvovec) for the treatment of Mucopolysaccharidosis Type II (MPS II)'. 'RGX-121-3102' is the protocol number of NCT07236606 (its org study id on ClinicalTrials.gov), which the registry also uses as the intervention name; the registrational CAMPSIITE study NCT03566043 already sits on the same asset row (3052)

Summit FY2025 10-K (0001599298-26-000015), notes to the financial statements: 'Ivonescimab, known as AK112 in China and Australia, and also as SMT112 in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Japan'. The registry files Summit's live studies under 'Ivonescimab Injection' (NCT05899608 HARMONi-3, NCT06767514 HARMONi-7, NCT07228832 HARMONi-GI3, the last as 'Drug: Ivonescimab Injection'), HARMONi (NCT06396065) under 'AK112 Injection', and NCT07815665 (Summit, Phase 2/3, ivonescimab with enfortumab vedotin against pembrolizumab with enfortumab vedotin) under the arms 'Ivonescimab Dose 1', 'Ivonescimab Dose 2' and 'Ivonescimab RP3D' (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-11-16).
